statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir' | sed "s|$HOME|~|"); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$used" ]; then context_info=$(printf " [Context: %.1f%% used]" "$used"); else context_info=""; fi; printf "\033[2m%s\033[0m \033[36m%s\033[0m%s" "$model" "$dir" "$context_info"
